captions.title: Humanoid robot: Unitree H2
captions.body: Its walking is controlled by one neural network

captions.title: Command: walk forward
captions.body: The network picks new joint targets 50 times a second

captions.title: Command: turn around
captions.body: Nobody wrote the steps for turning

captions.title: Command: walk back
captions.body: Learned by trial and error in simulation

captions.title: Command: stop
captions.body: It keeps its balance by itself
